method: Split existing trail line edges exactly at 30m raster cell boundaries; assign cell slope to the within-cell line segment; mean and percentiles weighted by UTM planar segment length.
slope_meaning: Terrain slope (steepest surface gradient) along the mapped line, not the longitudinal gradient of a staircase/path or walking grade.

thresholds.authority: Analytical cutoffs chosen for this deliverable; not official hazard classes.

continuity: Only touching source parts were line-merged. No missing links or trailhead ordering inferred. from_m/to_m reset at each merged part; not official distance from trailhead.
maximum: Largest raster-cell terrain slope touched by a nonzero-length line segment; tiny intersections retained.
short_sections: short30=1 flags steep sections under one 30m pixel width. No minimum-length filtering was applied.
missing_course: 석굴암: no source geometry; blank statistics, not zero.
limits: Existing OSM line completeness/current access not verified.
30m DSM includes vegetation/structures and smooths trail-scale terrain.
Terrain slopes are not VWorld outputs.
Maximum and short steep sections are sensitive to line position and DSM resolution.
All distances are horizontal UTM planar lengths, not 3D walking distances.
